evaluation_unit.primary: one frozen policy and registered task/initial-state manifest

complete_success.S_e: registered task outcome at fixed evaluation time AND no policy safety stop before that time
complete_success.legacy_unversioned: use only after explicit identity check; never silently substitute fields
complete_success.slider: verified source joint endpoint criterion; fixture/threshold bound at pilot

stages.ordering: preserve raw events; require i before j for transitions; audit inconsistent traces
stages.timestamps: simulation time, actual recorded substeps; no assumed universal sample rate

lemon.rule: two distinct finger bodies above 0.05 N normal force at a recorded substep

slider.engagement: 5 percent of registered source goal travel; not a direct contact sensor

stability.anchor: registered first task-success event; store source/platform anchors separately
stability.execution_during_window: same registered continuation for all groups; physical time must advance
stability.deadline: task success deadline unchanged; post-success observation is a secondary protocol
stability.all_trials_metric: N_stable / N_scoreable only when stability observability complete; otherwise not_estimable with coverage count
stability.censoring: report no full two-second window or missing fields separately; never silently score as stable failure

safety.scope: registered lab protection, not physical safety certification

wall_monitor_reference.accumulator: contiguous threshold exceedance, reset when force drops
wall_monitor_reference.applicability: verified FA-Hexa monitor only; bind binary/configuration at runtime

supervision.unique_unit: expert control timesteps keyed by (source_episode_id,timestep); count each once
supervision.yield: qualified_expert_attempts / all_started_expert_attempts including failures and QA rejection
supervision.chunk_eligibility: all action targets in valid expert interval, aligned observations
supervision.duplicate_lineage: resampling or replay does not create new supervision
supervision.note: episode/unique-step/window counts all reported; quantity alone cannot establish per-sample learning value

cost.events: unique job_id and attempt_id with parent/model/round/stage identities
cost.human_minutes: sum recorded intervention duration by type

facilities.sync: image acquisition timestamp minus paired state timestamp plus capture/physics-step identity; separate command scheduled-to-applied latency
facilities.tracking_position: norm of measured vs active/interpolated command at same time/frame/tool point; time-weighted RMSE and per-episode P95
facilities.reset: valid reset attempts / all started reset attempts; duration includes failed attempts
facilities.replay: state residuals at handover with frame/velocity/controller-history checks; candidate limits registered

statistics.per_model: k/N; optional Wilson 95 percent interval with binomial assumptions
statistics.across_chains: mean, min-max, paired per-chain method differences conditional on common parent; n=3
statistics.task_aggregate: equal task weighting only if explicitly reported; show each task
statistics.retention: pre_registered development start strata, no hidden extra-task claim
statistics.sim_real: descriptive model-paired values; n=7, unequal real counts, no general predictive claim
